LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.label: The Endless Traveler
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.description:
You are Neiyu, a Milira traveler seeking to make herself whole. You carry scattered memories, a share of your strength and a curiosity about this unfamiliar world. Your own armament is the one thing you can always rely on. Find a place to settle, build a home and take your time getting to know the people around you.
Warning: This scenario makes the game much easier. It is not recommended for a first playthrough.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.summa: An endless traveler on a journey with no known destination.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.parts: After many stops along the road, you've come to a place that looks promising. You've been traveling a long time and want somewhere to stay for a while. Memories come and go, but your goal couldn't be clearer: make yourself whole and keep a record of this world. You don't know why you feel that way or what it's all for. You've always been the sort of Milira who follows her whim. You can learn as you travel, or just as well by staying and living here.
